smoke_command: pip install asqav==0.4.5 cryptography; python -c "from asqav.keys import generate_local_keypair, SUPPORTED_ALGORITHMS; from asqav.local import local_sign; generate_local_keypair('ed25519'); local_sign(agent_id='wd-rival-check', action_type='tool_call', context={'tool':'read_file','offline':True}, queue_dir=<tmp>)"
notes: First real rival-local-check (2026-05-22). asqav 0.4.5 installs offline with only the optional `cryptography` dep. Local offline mode generates ed25519/es256 keypairs and QUEUES actions (queued_entry status=pending, no signature field). The headline ML-DSA-65 quantum-safe signature is NOT in SUPPORTED_ALGORITHMS for local keypairs (only ed25519/es256) and the queued entry carries no signature -- ML-DSA-65 signing and signed-receipt emission require the Asqav cloud service when the queue is flushed. cloud_dependency is therefore true: the offline path is real but does not produce the cryptographically-verified receipt that is Asqav's A2/A7 headline. This manifest deliberately does NOT contribute to consensus_grade (cloud_dependency=true => local_status=cloud_dependent in the matrix).
